notes.title: Bugfix & Polishing (Build 59)
notes.notes: [h3]Greetings Champions![/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve just released a new update with some bug fixes and extra polish.[/p][p]Thanks a ton for all the feedback! It really helps us track down issues and improve the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]The demo is back![/h3][p]Now with updated features and adjusted content, perfect to share with friends who are still not sure![/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p]New[/p][list][*][p]Added a small intro animation and adjusted tutorial pages for first-time players.[/p][/*][*][p]Brought back the updated demo version to share with friends.[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltips for Sanctum and Unveilings in the main menu to show how to unlock them.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a red preview highlight when dragging a card onto a Site if it can’t be played.[/p][/*][/list][p]Bugfix[/p][list][*][p]Fixed 'Brynhildr' always summoning from the leftmost slot when no Norse card was present.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 'Golden Apple' showing the wrong trigger effect type in the tooltip.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tutorial page not appearing after the boss intro as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed boss intros for 'Hel' and 'Medusa' being slightly misaligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 'Fafnir' displaying the wrong quotes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 'Divine Herald' temporarily becoming invisible when trying to summon another card.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Mana counter sometimes getting stuck.[/p][/*][/list][p]Update[/p][list][*][p]Unveilings now unlock after finishing 1 run (instead of reaching level 1).[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased font size for card tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Rearranged stat info in the card tooltip for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved clarity in the description for 'Tamamo no Mae'.[/p][/*][*][p]Made it clearer that your game is saved at the last cleared Aeon (checkpoint).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’re really thankful for your support and hope you’ve been enjoying Pantheion so far! [/p][p][/p][p]If you’ve got suggestions or run into bugs, hop into our Discord or drop a post on the Steam forum.[/p][p][/p][p]Pantheion Team[/p]
